Why do you know the content but still struggle to recall it while writing a UPSC Mains answer?

AIR 13 Ananya explains why revision cannot stop at two or three rounds. According to her, notes need to be revised repeatedly until the points become so familiar that your thoughts start coming faster than your writing speed.

This is not just about remembering more. It is about training your mind to retrieve the right points quickly when the clock is running.

A simple revision habit can make a big difference to your answer writing.
